resources.string: Report fraud or call a helpline
Call %1$s, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, right away. Reporting within the first few hours gives the best chance of stopping the money. Then call your bank to block your card or account.

Opens a complaint SMS with the message text, sender and date, in the format TRAI publishes. Check it before sending: your operator may reply if it needs changes. Complaints must be sent within a few days of the message.
For fake KYC, impersonation, fake customer care or prize messages. The message details are copied: on the Sanchar Saathi page choose the medium (SMS) and category, then paste them.
If you lost money or shared bank details. The message details are copied for the complaint form. Keep screenshots and transaction IDs ready.
Adds the sender to your phone\'s block list (also blocks their calls).

Dak doesn\'t list bank numbers it hasn\'t verified. Save your bank\'s card-block number here so it\'s one tap away when you need it.
Copy it from the back of your card or your bank\'s official website, never from an SMS or a search result.
